records.jp: たまに撮ってた写真、気付いたら<CR>けっこうたまってるなー。……でも
records.en_original: Oh, wow. I didn't realize how many photos I've taken.
records.en: Oh, wow. I didn't realize how many photos I've taken.

records.jp: あとどれぐらい、みんなといられるんだろう。<CR>もっと、みんなのこと思い出に残しておきたいな
records.en_original: But... I wonder how much longer I'll get to be with everyone. I wish I could record more memories.
records.en: But... I wonder how much longer I'll get to be with everyone. I wish I could record more memories.

records.jp: あっ、そうだ！　写真じゃなくて、動画！<CR>ひとりずつ動画で、残せばいいんだ！
records.en_original: Oh, I know! I should be taking videos instead of pictures! I should get one with each one of the girls!
records.en: Oh, I know! I should be taking videos instead of pictures! I should get one with each one of the girls!

records.jp: そうと決まれば、誰から撮りに行こうかな？
records.en_original: All right, now who should I start with?
records.en: All right, now who should I start with?

records.jp: こころー！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Kokoro! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Kokoro! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: え？　インタビューって、なんです？
records.en_original: Questions...? For what?
records.en: Questions...? For what?

records.jp: 簡単な質問だから、大丈夫だよ。<CR>直感で答えちゃって！
records.en_original: Don't worry, it'll be quick! Just say the first thing that comes to mind!
records.en: Don't worry, it'll be quick! Just say the first thing that comes to mind!

records.jp: えーと……この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: うーん……<CR>愛央ちゃんと、図書室に行った時のことかな
records.en_original: Umm... That time you and I went to the library, I guess.
records.en: Hmm... Maybe when you and I went to the library, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんが、「屍神の法則」の話を<CR>してくれたの覚えてない？
records.en_original: Do you remember telling me about The Death God Theory?
records.en: Don't you remember when Ao-chan told me about The Death God Theory?

records.jp: 覚えてるけど……それが印象に残ってんの？
records.en_original: I do, but... That's really what comes to mind?
records.en: I do, but... That's really what comes to mind?

records.jp: あの時さ、自分のことが何も思い出せなくて<CR>結構不安だったんだよね……
records.en_original: I was so anxious back then because I couldn't remember anything about myself.
records.en: I was so anxious back then because I couldn't remember anything about myself.

records.jp: でも、愛央ちゃんの嬉しそうな顔を見たら<CR>これから先、なんとかなるかもって思えて……
records.en_original: But seeing you smile helped me feel hopeful that things would work out.
records.en: But seeing your happy face made me feel like we'd somehow be okay from then on, Ao-chan...

records.jp: 暗いことばかり考えてても仕方ないし<CR>前向きに頑張ってみようかなーって思えたんだ
records.en_original: You helped me realize that there's no point in dwelling on negative thoughts and that I should try to keep moving forward.
records.en: You helped me realize that there's no point in dwelling on negative thoughts and that I should try to keep moving forward.

records.jp: ……こころが、そんな風に思ってたなんて<CR>知らなかったよ
records.en_original: I had no idea you felt that way, Kokoro.
records.en: I had no idea you felt that way, Kokoro.

records.jp: ふふっ、だって言ってないもん
records.en_original: Hehe, that's because I never told you.
records.en: Hehe, that's because I never told you.

records.jp: ……ね、わたしからも愛央ちゃんにも質問！<CR>なんで急に、動画を撮りたいって思ったの？
records.en_original: I have a question for you too, Ao! Why are you recording this?
records.en: I have a question for you too, Ao-chan! Why are you recording this?

records.jp: なんでって……みんなとの思い出を<CR>残しておきたかったから？
records.en_original: Why...? I guess I just wanted to leave some kind of record of our time together.
records.en: Why...? I guess I just wanted to leave some kind of record of our time together.

records.jp: ……どうして、残しておきたいって思ったの？
records.en_original: Why did you think that?
records.en: Why did you think that?

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん……不安だったんじゃない？　この世界が<CR>終わったら、わたしたちの繋がりも消えるって……
records.en_original: Ao... Are you worried that our bond will be broken when this world comes to an end?
records.en: Ao-chan... Are you worried that our bond will be broken when this world comes to an end?

records.jp: その気持ち、わたしもよく分かる。<CR>これからどうなるのか……不安だよね
records.en_original: I feel the same way. I'm...scared of what might happen after this.
records.en: I feel the same way. I'm...scared of what might happen after this.

records.jp: でも、わたしたちは、きっと大丈夫だよ。<CR>どんなに離れていても、記憶をなくしたとしても
records.en_original: But I know that we'll be okay. No matter how far apart we are... Even if we lose our memories...
records.en: But I know that we'll be okay. No matter how far apart we are... Even if we lose our memories...

records.jp: 心の繋がりだけは、絶対に消えない。<CR>みんなのこと、絶対に忘れたりしない
records.en_original: Our bond will never be broken. I will never forget any of our friends.
records.en: Our bond will never be broken. I will never forget any of our friends.

records.jp: 大好きな愛央ちゃんのこと……<CR>わたしが、忘れるわけないのです
records.en_original: Especially you... There is no way I would ever forget you, Ao.
records.en: Especially you... There is no way I would ever forget you, Ao-chan.

records.jp: こころ……
records.en_original: Kokoro...
records.en: Kokoro...

records.jp: あれ？　今、撮った動画、消しちゃったの？
records.en_original: Hm? Wait, you're deleting that video?
records.en: Hm? Wait, you're deleting that video?

records.jp: うん。これがなくても、<CR>私たちは、もう一度会えるから
records.en_original: Yeah. I don't need it, 'cause I'm sure we'll meet again.
records.en: Yeah. I don't need it, 'cause I'm sure we'll meet again.

records.jp: 想い出にすがるより、みんなとの絆を信じたい。<CR>……そうだよね、こころ！
records.en_original: I'd rather believe in the bonds between us than cling onto old memories! ...Right, Kokoro?
records.en: I'd rather believe in the bonds between us than cling onto old memories! ...Right, Kokoro?

records.jp: うん！<CR>わたしたち、ずっとずっと友たちなのです！
records.en_original: Right! We will always be friends!
records.en: Right! We will always be friends!

records.jp: （……ありがとう、こころ。こころのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Kokoro. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Kokoro. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 勇希！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Yuki! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Yuki! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: へ？　インタビュー？<CR>愛央もたいがい、いきなり来るよね～
records.en_original: Huh? Like an interview? You really are random, Ao.
records.en: Huh? Like an interview? You really are random, Ao.

records.jp: へへ。じゃ、私が質問するから、答えてくれる？
records.en_original: Hehe. I'll take that as a yes.
records.en: Hehe. I'll take that as a yes.

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: そんなの、決まってるじゃん。<CR>あたしがホントに生きててびっくり、ってヤツ
records.en_original: Oh, that's easy! Being alive!
records.en: Oh, that's easy! Being alive!

records.jp: 伶那さんと両想いでサイコー、とかじゃないの？<CR>正直に言っちゃっていーんだよー？
records.en_original: Not something like being together with Rena? You can be honest, you know!
records.en: Not something like being together with Rena-san? You can be honest, you know!

records.jp: ていうかさ、愛央。これ、いつもの遊びじゃないよね？<CR>愛央の顔、ホントに笑ってない
records.en_original: Ao, you're not just playing around this time, are you? You're not smiling the way you usually do.
records.en: Ao, you're not just playing around this time, are you? You're not smiling the way you usually do.

records.jp: なんで、そんなに無理して笑って、<CR>インタビューとか撮ってるわけ？
records.en_original: Why are you forcing yourself to put on this fake smile to record this interview?
records.en: Why are you forcing yourself to put on this fake smile to record this interview?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)

records.jp: …………愛央。<CR>ムリして言葉、探さなくたっていいよ
records.en_original: Ao... Don't force yourself to say something if nothing is coming to mind.
records.en: Ao... Don't force yourself to say something if nothing is coming to mind.

records.jp: それこそ、嘘の言葉しか出てこないしさ
records.en_original: It would just be a lie.
records.en: It would just be a lie.

records.jp: ……うん
records.en_original: ...Yeah.
records.en: ...Yeah.

records.jp: 元の世界で、あたしが生きてる未来に期待！　とか、<CR>絶対忘れないでいてみせる！　とか、全部嘘
records.en_original: "I'm sure I'll be alive in the future!" "I promise I'll never forget!" Those are all lies.
records.en: "I'm sure I'll be alive in the future!" "I promise I'll never forget!" Those are all lies.

records.jp: あたしは不安でいっぱいだよ。<CR>だから……愛央だけ不安じゃないわけないじゃん？
records.en_original: The truth is, I'm terrified. So there's no way you aren't scared too, Ao.
records.en: The truth is, I'm terrified. So there's no way you aren't scared too, Ao.

records.jp: （そっか……私、不安だったんだ……）
records.en_original: (I see... I was scared...)
records.en: (I see... I was scared...)

records.jp: でもさ、これだけは信じてるんだ
records.en_original: But there is one thing I believe.
records.en: But there is one thing I believe.

records.jp: いろいろあったけど、あたしたちの日々は嘘じゃない。<CR>あたしたちが友達なのも、嘘になんかならない
records.en_original: We've been through a lot, and all of it was real. The fact that we're friends is as real as it gets.
records.en: We've been through a lot, and all of it was real. The fact that we're friends is as real as it gets.

records.jp: もし忘れてたって、あたしの心の中には、<CR>大切な印として刻まれて、きっと思い出せるって
records.en_original: Even if we forget everything, that fact will remain in my heart, and I will remember it.
records.en: Even if we forget everything, that fact will remain in my heart, and I will remember it.

records.jp: ……大切な、印……かぁ。<CR>たまにはいいこと言うじゃん
records.en_original: It will remain in your heart... That's beautiful.
records.en: It will remain in your heart... That's beautiful.

records.jp: せっかく撮ったのに、消しちゃうの？
records.en_original: You're deleting the video you just took?
records.en: You're deleting the video you just took?

records.jp: うん。必要ないって教えてくれたの、勇希じゃん。<CR>私の心にも、みんなとの絆は絶対刻まれてるからさ
records.en_original: Yeah. You taught me that I don't need it, Yuki. Our friendship will remain in my heart too.
records.en: Yeah. You taught me that I don't need it, Yuki. Our friendship will remain in my heart too.

records.jp: ……強がってないよね？
records.en_original: You're not just putting on a front, are you?
records.en: You're not just putting on a front, are you?

records.jp: 強がってないよ。<CR>勇希が、元気を分けてくれたじゃん
records.en_original: Not at all. You gave me the strength to understand that, Yuki.
records.en: Not at all. You gave me the strength to understand that, Yuki.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、勇希。勇希のおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Yuki. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Yuki. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 伶那さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Rena! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Rena! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビュー？<CR>……はいはい、またあなたの思い付きってやつね
records.en_original: For what? Is this another one of your antics?
records.en: For what? Is this another one of your antics?

records.jp: はーい、そうでーっす！<CR>えーと、まずは……
records.en_original: You know it! So, first of all...
records.en: You know it! So, first of all...

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: ……私が、勇希のことを好きなんだって思い出した後、<CR>記憶のない勇希を見るたび苦しくなったこと、かな
records.en_original: I suppose...how hurt I felt every time I saw Yuki without her memory after I got mine back and remembered that I love her.
records.en: I suppose...how hurt I felt every time I saw Yuki without her memory after I got mine back and remembered that I love her.

records.jp: でも、苦しい毎日のおかげで<CR>思い知ったんだ
records.en_original: But it was thanks to those unbearable days that I came to realize...
records.en: But it was thanks to those unbearable days that I came to realize...

records.jp: 勇希のためなら、私はどんな事情も蹴っ飛ばして<CR>隣に立つ努力ができるんだってこと！
records.en_original: That I can endure anything for the sake of being with her.
records.en: That I can endure anything for the sake of being with her.

records.jp: ……なんだか伶那さん、きらきらしてる
records.en_original: ...Rena, you're glowing.
records.en: ...Rena-san, you're glowing.

records.jp: そういう星崎さんは、なんか沈んでるね<CR>
records.en_original: You probably only think that because you're so gloomy.
records.en: You're the one who looks kind of down, Hoshizaki-san.<CR>

records.jp: えっ！？　そ、そうかな？
records.en_original: Wha—?! Am I really?
records.en: Wha—?! Am I really?

records.jp: うん、絶対にそう。<CR>しかも急に動画を撮り始めたりしてさ、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Definitely. This whole video thing, too. What's going on? Why are you doing this?
records.en: Definitely. This whole video thing, too. What's going on? Why are you doing this?

records.jp: それ、は……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)

records.jp: もしかして、不安になっちゃった？
records.en_original: Did you suddenly start to feel worried?
records.en: Did you suddenly start to feel worried?

records.jp: ……不安？
records.en_original: ...Worried?
records.en: ...Worried?

records.jp: 離れ離れになった後、私たちのことを<CR>思い出す自信がなくなった……なんて言わないよね？
records.en_original: You're not going to say you no longer believe that you'll remember us after we part ways, are you?
records.en: You're not going to say you no longer believe that you'll remember us after we part ways, are you?

records.jp: （そうか。私、不安だったんだ。<CR>簡単に消えるデータに、すがっちゃうくらいに）
records.en_original: (I get it now... I was worried. So worried that I was going to depend on some video that could be deleted at the touch of a button.)
records.en: (I get it now... I was worried. So worried that I was going to depend on some video that could be deleted at the touch of a button.)

records.jp: あーあ、動画消しちゃったんだ？<CR>良かったの？
records.en_original: Did you just delete the video? Are you okay with that?
records.en: Did you just delete the video? Are you okay with that?

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: だって、思い出す自信、ちゃーんとあるもんね！<CR>伶那さんのことも、みんなのことも！
records.en_original: I'm sure I'll remember you and the others! No problem!
records.en: Because I'm totally confident I'll remember you, Rena-san, and everyone else!

records.jp: あはっ、自信満々じゃん。<CR>ま、せいぜい頑張りなよ
records.en_original: Hah! How confident you are now. Well, good luck.
records.en: Hah! How confident you are now. Well, good luck.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、伶那さん。伶那さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Rena. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Rena-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 日菜子さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Hinako! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Hinako! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビュー？<CR>いいよ、何を話せばいい？
records.en_original: Sure. About what?
records.en: Sure. About what?

records.jp: さすが日菜子さん！　話が分かる！<CR>えーと、まずは……
records.en_original: Great! I knew I could count on you. So, first of all...
records.en: That's Hinako-san for you! You get it! First...

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: 印象に残ってることか……<CR>やっぱり、カフェでみんなと出会ったときのことかな
records.en_original: What I remember most... Probably when we all first met at the cafe.
records.en: What I remember most... Probably when we all first met at the cafe.

records.jp: あの後、他のみんなから聞いたんだよね。<CR>私が目覚めたきっかけは、詩帆との約束の言葉だって
records.en_original: I found out later that it was thanks to Shiho's promise to me that I woke up.
records.en: I found out later that it was thanks to Shiho's promise to me that I woke up.

records.jp: 詩帆があんな些細な約束を覚えていてくれたことも、<CR>私の中にそれが強く残ってたことも、嬉しかった
records.en_original: I was so happy that Shiho remembered such a small promise and that it stayed with me as well.
records.en: I was so happy that Shiho remembered such a small promise and that it stayed with me as well.

records.jp: ……えへへ、なんかいい話だなあ。<CR>しっかり記録しておくね！
records.en_original: Hehehe, that's such a wholesome story! I'll be sure to keep this recording safe!
records.en: Hehehe, that's such a wholesome story! I'll be sure to keep this recording safe!

records.jp: よろしく！　あ、記録っていえば……<CR>どうしていきなり、動画を撮り始めたの？
records.en_original: Thanks! Um, but...come to think of it, why are you recording a video in the first place?
records.en: Thanks! Um, but...come to think of it, why are you recording a video in the first place?

records.jp: それは……
records.en_original: Well...
records.en: Well...

records.jp: （あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)

records.jp: ねえ愛央。もし不安になったんなら、<CR>たくさんたくさん、話をしよう？
records.en_original: Hey, Ao? If you're feeling anxious, let's just talk to each other as much as we can.
records.en: Hey, Ao? If you're feeling anxious, let's just talk to each other as much as we can.

records.jp: 残されたこの時間を、うんと大切にしようよ。<CR>愛央と私たちなら、きっとそれができる
records.en_original: We should cherish the time we have left together. I'm sure you and I can make the best of it.
records.en: We should cherish the time we have left together. I'm sure you and I can make the best of it.

records.jp: （そっか……日菜子さんのおかげで、分かった。<CR>私、不安だったんだ）
records.en_original: (Of course... Thanks to Hinako, I get it now. I've been so anxious.)
records.en: (Of course... Thanks to Hinako-san, I get it now. I've been so anxious.)

records.jp: 動画、消したんだね
records.en_original: You deleted the video?
records.en: You deleted the video?

records.jp: ……うん！　今は画面越しじゃなくて<CR>日菜子さんと直接話したいから！
records.en_original: Yeah! I want to talk to you face to face, not through some screen.
records.en: ...Yeah! Right now I want to talk directly to you, Hinako-san, not through a screen!

records.jp: そっか。……じゃ、場所を変えようか。<CR>ついでに、詩帆にお菓子でもねだってみる？
records.en_original: I see. Then, let's go somewhere else. Why don't we go hound Shiho for some snacks while we're at it?
records.en: I see. Then, let's go somewhere else. Why don't we go hound Shiho for some snacks while we're at it?

records.jp: やったー！　日菜子さんてばやっぱり分かってる！
records.en_original: Yeah! You always know exactly what to say, Hinako!
records.en: Yeah! You always know exactly what to say, Hinako-san!

records.jp: （……ありがとう、日菜子さん。日菜子さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Hinako. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Hinako-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 詩帆さん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Shiho! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Shiho-san! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビュー？<CR>ちゃんとできるでしょうか……？
records.en_original: You want to interview me? I hope I don't disappoint.
records.en: You want to interview me? I hope I don't disappoint.

records.jp: 遊びみたいなもんだから、リラックスだよ！<CR>えーと、まずは……
records.en_original: Relax, it's just for fun! So, first of all...
records.en: Relax, it's just for fun! So, first of all...

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: うーん……やっぱり、初めてココロトープに<CR>入るとなったときのこと、ですね
records.en_original: Hmm... Perhaps the time I first entered my Heartscape?
records.en: Hmm... Perhaps the time I first entered my Heartscape?

records.jp: こころと愛央さんは、ココロトープに怯えるわたしを<CR>否定せずにいてくれた……とても心強かったです
records.en_original: You and Kokoro stood by me, even when I was afraid. It was very reassuring.
records.en: You and Kokoro did not reject me even when I was afraid of the Heartscape, Ao-san... It was very reassuring.

records.jp: そっか……<CR>詩帆さんの力になれたのなら、よかった！
records.en_original: I see... I'm glad we were able to help!
records.en: I see... I'm glad I could help Shiho-san!

records.jp: ……あの、星崎さん。<CR>わたしからも質問をいいですか？
records.en_original: Would it be all right for me to ask you a question, Hoshizaki?
records.en: Would it be all right for me to ask you a question, Hoshizaki-san?

records.jp: このインタビュー動画、<CR>どうして撮ろうと思ったんでしょう？
records.en_original: Why are you making this video?
records.en: Why are you making this video?

records.jp: （えっと……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why am I?)

records.jp: 星崎さんが不安そうな目をしているから、気になって。<CR>事情があるなら、話を聞かせてください
records.en_original: You look upset. If there is something on your mind, you know you can talk to me.
records.en: You looked uneasy, Hoshizaki-san, so I was concerned. If something is going on, please tell me.

records.jp: 話すだけで楽になることもあるって、<CR>星崎さんたちが教えてくれたんですよ？
records.en_original: There are some things that can be resolved just by talking. You taught me that, Ao.
records.en: There are some things that can be resolved just by talking. You taught me that, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: （そうか。私、不安で……<CR>形に残るものを欲しがってたんだ。でも──）
records.en_original: (I see. I was so upset that I felt the need to make some kind of memento. But...)
records.en: (I see. I was so upset that I felt the need to make some kind of memento. But...)

records.jp: えっ？　動画、消してしまったんですか？
records.en_original: Hm? Did you delete the video?
records.en: Hm? Did you delete the video?

records.jp: うん。……今はインタビューより、<CR>詩帆さんに話を聞いてほしくなっちゃった！
records.en_original: Yeah. I figured I'd rather talk to you instead of doing some interview.
records.en: Yeah... Right now, I'd rather have you listen to me, Shiho-san, than do an interview!

records.jp: そう、ですか……ふふ、分かりました。<CR>いっぱいお話して、いっぱい思い出を作りましょうね
records.en_original: Oh, really? Hehe, all right then. Let's talk and make many more memories together.
records.en: Oh, really? Hehe, all right then. Let's talk and make many more memories together.

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: （……ありがとう、詩帆さん。詩帆さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Shiho. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Shiho-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: きららー！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Kirara! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Kirara! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: そういうのはマネージャーを<CR>通してもらわないと、困るのだが
records.en_original: I would prefer that you go through my agent for such things.
records.en: I would prefer that you go through my agent for such things.

records.jp: 事務所から撮影許可はもらってます！
records.en_original: I got your agency's permission to film!
records.en: I got your agency's permission to film!

records.jp: ふむ……そういうことなら、いいだろう。<CR>特別に、答えてやるぞ
records.en_original: Hm... In that case, I will allow it.
records.en: Hm... In that case, I will allow it.

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: 一番……<CR>神の声が聞こえなくなったこと、だな
records.en_original: What I remember most... That would be losing the ability to hear the Divine.
records.en: What I remember most... That would be losing the ability to hear the Divine.

records.jp: きららにとっての当たり前が、この世界では<CR>当たり前ではなくなった
records.en_original: Something that I had taken for granted for so long no longer existed for me in this world.
records.en: What Kirara had always taken for granted was no longer normal in this world.

records.jp: だから、時々分からなくなったのだ。<CR>ここにいるきららは、本当にきららなのかと
records.en_original: So, sometimes I cannot tell if the Kirara I am here is truly the real Kirara.
records.en: So sometimes Kirara wondered whether the Kirara here was truly Kirara.

records.jp: でも……みんなは、そんなきららを受け入れて<CR>仲間だって言ってくれた
records.en_original: But everyone accepted me regardless. You all said I was one of you.
records.en: But everyone accepted that Kirara and said she was one of them.

records.jp: 今のままのきららでも、いいのだと……<CR>みんなのおかげで、知ることが出来たのだ
records.en_original: Thanks to everyone here, I now understand that it is acceptable for me to just be me...
records.en: Thanks to everyone, Kirara learned that it was all right for Kirara to remain as she is...

records.jp: つまり、きららにとって、一番印象的だったのは<CR>みんなと友達になれたことか！
records.en_original: So you're saying that becoming friends with everyone is the best thing that happened to you here!
records.en: So you're saying that becoming friends with everyone is the best thing that happened to you here!

records.jp: まあ……<CR>そうとも言えなくもないかもしれなくもない
records.en_original: Well... I suppose you could put it that way.
records.en: Well... I suppose you could put it that way.

records.jp: あはは！　照れない、照れない！
records.en_original: Ahaha! Aww, don't be embarrassed!
records.en: Ahaha! Aww, don't be embarrassed!

records.jp: むう……やっぱり、その動画は消すべきだ。<CR>肖像権の侵害で訴える……
records.en_original: Urgh... I demand you delete that video. It's an invasion of privacy.
records.en: Urgh... I demand you delete that video. It's an invasion of privacy.

records.jp: ええー！？　ダメダメ！<CR>みんなのこと、動画に残すんだから！
records.en_original: What?! No way! I want to have a video of everybody!
records.en: What?! No way! I want to have a video of everybody!

records.jp: みんなも？　なぜ、動画に残すのだ？
records.en_original: Everybody? Why?
records.en: Everybody? Why?

records.jp: なぜって、それは……
records.en_original: Well, because...
records.en: Well, because...

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why do I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why do I?)

records.jp: ……そうか。<CR>愛央も不安だったのだな
records.en_original: I see. You're scared, aren't you, Ao?
records.en: I see. You're scared, aren't you, Ao?

records.jp: この世界が消滅すれば、すべてが無に還る。<CR>そして、すべてが新しく始まる……
records.en_original: If this world comes to an end, everything will be lost, and everything must start anew.
records.en: If this world comes to an end, everything will be lost, and everything must start anew.

records.jp: 愛央は、残しておきたかったんだな。<CR>ここで過ごした、みんなとの記録を……
records.en_original: So you wanted to keep some kind of record of the time we spent here together.
records.en: So you wanted to keep some kind of record of the time we spent here together.

records.jp: 愛央。すべてがリセットされたとしても……<CR>きららは愛央のことを絶対に忘れたりしない
records.en_original: Ao, even if everything is reset, I will never forget you.
records.en: Ao. Even if everything is reset... Kirara will never forget you.

records.jp: ここに……<CR>心に、愛央の姿も声も刻み付けておくから
records.en_original: I will carve your form, your voice, your very name onto my soul.
records.en: I will carve your form, your voice, your very name onto my soul.

records.jp: きららたちは、繋がってる。<CR>……どんなに離れていても、ずっと一緒だ
records.en_original: We will always be connected, no matter how far apart we are from each other.
records.en: Kirara and the others are connected. ...No matter how far apart everyone is, they'll always be together.

records.jp: きらら……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: ……動画、消すのか？
records.en_original: You're...deleting the video?
records.en: You're...deleting the video?

records.jp: うん。これは、必要ないから
records.en_original: Yeah. I don't need it.
records.en: Yeah. I don't need it.

records.jp: この先何があったって、私たちの絆は消えない。<CR>……そうだよね、きらら！
records.en_original: No matter what happens, our friendship isn't going anywhere. Right, Kirara?
records.en: No matter what happens, our friendship isn't going anywhere. Right, Kirara?

records.jp: うむ。<CR>きららたちの友情は永遠に不滅だ
records.en_original: Indeed. Our friendship is eternal.
records.en: Indeed. The friendship Kirara shares with everyone is eternal and indestructible.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、きらら。きららのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Kirara. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Kirara. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 陽桜莉さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Hiori! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Hiori! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビュー？<CR>うん、私に答えられることなら
records.en_original: Questions? Sure, as long as I know the answers.
records.en: Questions? Sure, as long as I know the answers.

records.jp: えーっと……この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: Let's see... What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: もちろん、愛央ちゃんと一緒に遊んだことだよ！
records.en_original: Hanging out with you, of course!
records.en: Hanging out with you, Ao-chan, of course!

records.jp: 二人で、色んな場所に行ったけど<CR>ぜーんぶ、楽しかった！
records.en_original: We went to lots of different places together, but they were all so fun!
records.en: We went to lots of different places together, but they were all so fun!

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんと一緒にいると、胸の中の<CR>モヤモヤしたものが、綺麗になくなっちゃうの
records.en_original: All my problems just disappear when I'm with you.
records.en: When I am with you, Ao-chan, all the murky feelings in my chest disappear completely.

records.jp: それで、私も、もっともっと頑張ろうっ！って、<CR>前向きな気持ちになれたんだよ
records.en_original: That helped me stay positive and keep moving forward even when things were tough.
records.en: That helped me stay positive and keep moving forward even when things were tough.

records.jp: あはは……それはさすがに、褒めすぎ。<CR>え、えっと、じゃあ、次の質問ね！
records.en_original: Ahaha... You're too sweet! U-um, okay, next question...
records.en: Ahaha... You're too sweet! U-um, okay, next question...

records.jp: あ、待って。私からも質問したい！<CR>どうして急にインタビューなんて始めたの？
records.en_original: Hey, wait. I want to ask something too. Why did you feel like doing this interview all of a sudden?
records.en: Hey, wait. I want to ask something too. Why did you feel like doing this interview all of a sudden?

records.jp: それは、みんなのことを<CR>動画に残しておこうかなと思って
records.en_original: I just wanted to have a recording of everybody.
records.en: I just wanted to have a recording of everybody.

records.jp: ……動画に残しても、全部消えちゃうのに？
records.en_original: Even though the videos will disappear?
records.en: Even though the videos will disappear?

records.jp: ……そっか。<CR>愛央ちゃんは不安だったんだね
records.en_original: ...Oh. You're scared, huh, Ao?
records.en: ...Oh. You're scared, huh, Ao-chan?

records.jp: この世界が消えてしまったら、<CR>私たちの繋がりも消えてしまうんじゃないかって
records.en_original: It scares you to think that our bond could disappear along with this world, right?
records.en: It scares you to think that our bond could disappear along with this world, right?

records.jp: 私もね、同じこと考えてたから、<CR>愛央ちゃんの気持ち少しだけ分かるんだ
records.en_original: I get that. I was thinking the same thing.
records.en: I was thinking the same thing, so I understand how Ao-chan feels, at least a little.

records.jp: でも……本当にそうなのかな？<CR>本当にすべて、リセットされちゃうのかな？
records.en_original: But is that really what's going to happen? Is everything really going to be reset?
records.en: But is that really what's going to happen? Is everything really going to be reset?

records.jp: ……どういうこと？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: この世界に来た時、私たちは何もかも忘れていた。<CR>……それでも、思い出すことが出来たよね
records.en_original: We didn't remember anything when we first came to this world, but we were able to regain our memories.
records.en: We didn't remember anything when we first came to this world, but we were able to regain our memories.

records.jp: 良いことも悪いことも……全部。<CR>それって、心がそれを求めていたからだと思うの
records.en_original: The good, the bad... All of it. I think the only reason that was possible was because our hearts longed for those memories.
records.en: The good, the bad... All of it. I think the only reason that was possible was because our hearts longed for those memories.

records.jp: 想いが力になるのなら……強く願えばいい。<CR>絶対に、絶対に、みんなのことは忘れないって。
records.en_original: So maybe all we have to do is wish as hard as we can that we'll never, ever forget each other.
records.en: So maybe all we have to do is wish as hard as we can that we'll never, ever forget each other.

records.jp: 私は……大好きな人を、忘れたりしないよ。<CR>必ず、愛央ちゃんに会えるって信じてる
records.en_original: I refuse to forget the people I love. I know I'll see you again, Ao.
records.en: I refuse to forget the people I love. I know I'll see you again, Ao-chan.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さん……
records.en_original: Hiori...
records.en: Hiori-san...

records.jp: あれ……動画、消しちゃうの？
records.en_original: Huh? You're deleting the video?
records.en: Huh? You're deleting the video?

records.jp: うん。<CR>陽桜莉さんのおかげで、必要ないって分かったから
records.en_original: Yeah. You helped me realize I don't need it.
records.en: Yeah. Thanks to you, Hiori-san, I realized I don't need it.

records.jp: この世界が消えても私たちの絆が消えるわけじゃない。<CR>……そうだよね、陽桜莉さん！
records.en_original: Even if this world disappears, our bond never will. Right, Hiori?
records.en: Even if this world disappears, our bond never will. Right, Hiori-san?

records.jp: うん！　新しい世界でも、また一緒に遊ぼうね。<CR>愛央ちゃん！
records.en_original: Yeah! Let's meet up and hang out in the new world, Ao!
records.en: Yeah! Let's meet up and hang out in the new world, Ao-chan!

records.jp: （……ありがとう、陽桜莉さん。陽桜莉さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Hiori. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Hiori-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 美弦さーん！<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Mio! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Mio! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビュー？　愛央らしく唐突ね。<CR>で、場所はここでいいの？
records.en_original: That's very sudden. Here?
records.en: That's very sudden. Here?

records.jp: うん。陽桜莉さんが美弦さんを見つけるきっかけに<CR>なった場所だから
records.en_original: Yeah. This place holds a lot of memories! It's how Hiori was able to find you.
records.en: Yeah. Because this is the place that led Hiori-san to find you, Mio-san.

records.jp: ……ふふ。そうね
records.en_original: Hehe... That's right.
records.en: Hehe... That's right.

records.jp: じゃ、行くよ！　質問でーす！
records.en_original: Here we go! First question!
records.en: Here we go! First question!

records.jp: この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか！
records.en_original: What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: 印象に残っていること……そうね……
records.en_original: What I remember most... Hmm...
records.en: What I remember most... Hmm...

records.jp: 陽桜莉と再会できた時、あの子のことしか<CR>覚えていなかったことかしら
records.en_original: Probably the fact that when Hiori and I were reuinted, she was the only person I remembered.
records.en: Probably the fact that when Hiori and I were reuinted, she was the only person I remembered.

records.jp: そして……もう一つは、あなたのこと
records.en_original: And also... You.
records.en: And also... You.

records.jp: へ？　私？
records.en_original: Huh? Me?
records.en: Huh? Me?

records.jp: 清々しいくらい何も考えずに突進するかと思えば、<CR>みんなのことは誰よりも考えていて……
records.en_original: You rush into things without thinking at all, yet you also think so much about all of us..
records.en: You rush into things without thinking at all, yet you also think so much about all of us..

records.jp: あなたを見ていて、飽きることはなかったわ。<CR>……眩しかった
records.en_original: You were never a bore to watch. You were...dazzling.
records.en: You were never a bore to watch. You were...dazzling.

records.jp: ま、眩しいとか、照れるんですけど……。<CR>え、えっとそれじゃあ、次の質問……
records.en_original: Y-you're making me blush... U-um, so the next question is...
records.en: Y-you're making me blush... U-um, so the next question is...

records.jp: 待って、愛央。<CR>どうして急にインタビューなんか始めたの？
records.en_original: Hang on, Ao. Why did you start doing this interview out of nowhere?
records.en: Hang on, Ao. Why did you start doing this interview out of nowhere?

records.jp: いつもの突発的な思い付き<CR>……じゃ、なさそうね
records.en_original: It doesn't seem like one of your usual antics.
records.en: It doesn't seem like one of your usual antics.

records.jp: （……あれ？　どうしてなんだろう？<CR>答えが出てこない……）
records.en_original: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)
records.en: (Why...? I...I don't know. Why did I?)

records.jp: 元の世界へ戻ったら、この日々も私たちのことも、<CR>全て忘れて、すれ違っても分からないかもしれない
records.en_original: I think you're afraid of forgetting about us and our time here when we return to our world.
records.en: I think you're afraid of forgetting about us and our time here when we return to our world.

records.jp: それが不安で、せめて動画に残したくなった。<CR>……違う？
records.en_original: And that fear made you feel the need to try to create some type of record. Am I wrong?
records.en: And that fear made you feel the need to try to create some type of record. Am I wrong?

records.jp: 私……そっか。不安、だったんだ……。<CR>気持ちの整理はできてると思ってたのになぁ
records.en_original: Scared...? Yeah...I was. And here I thought I had my feelings in order.
records.en: Scared...? Yeah...I was. And here I thought I had my feelings in order.

records.jp: 大丈夫。誰もが同じ不安を抱えていると思う。<CR>でも……こんな風にも思うの
records.en_original: It's okay. I think we're all worried about the same thing. But think of it this way...
records.en: It's okay. I think we're all worried about the same thing. But think of it this way...

records.jp: 私たちの日々は、間違いなく輝いていた。<CR>心の繋がりを、大切に深めてきた
records.en_original: Our time together shone more brightly than anything else. We tied deep bonds with one another.
records.en: Our time together shone more brightly than anything else. We tied deep bonds with one another.

records.jp: だから……あなた風に言うなら、何とかなる。<CR>私たちの絆は、世界の法則だって乗り越えられる
records.en_original: So, as you would say, it'll work out. These bonds will certainly transcend the laws of the world.
records.en: So, as you would say, it'll work out. These bonds will certainly transcend the laws of the world.

records.jp: 初めてここに来た時も、陽桜莉のことだけは<CR>覚えていたのだもの。きっと、忘れないわ
records.en_original: I still remembered Hiori when I first came to this world. I'm sure I will remember you as well.
records.en: I still remembered Hiori when I first came to this world. I'm sure I will remember you as well.

records.jp: ……うん！　そうだよ。<CR>こんなの、私らしくないよね！
records.en_original: Yeah... You're right! It's not like me to worry!
records.en: Yeah... You're right! It's not like me to worry!

records.jp: きっと何とかなる！　大事な人たちのこと、<CR>絶対に忘れたりしないし、絆はなくならない！
records.en_original: It'll work out! I won't forget about the people I love, and our bonds will never disappear!
records.en: It'll work out! I won't forget about the people I love, and our bonds will never disappear!

records.jp: ええ。もし忘れていても、必ず思い出せる。<CR>そしてね……
records.en_original: That's right. And even if we do forget, our memories will come back to us.
records.en: That's right. And even if we do forget, our memories will come back to us.

records.jp: あなたと陽桜莉が赤点を取らないように、<CR>まとめて面倒を見てあげる
records.en_original: I promise I won't ever let you or Hiori fail. I'll always keep an eye on you two.
records.en: I promise I won't ever let you or Hiori fail. I'll always keep an eye on you two.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、美弦さん。美弦さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Mio. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Mio-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)

records.jp: 詩さん。<CR>今から、インタビューするから答えてくんない？
records.en_original: Hey, Uta! Mind if I ask you some questions?
records.en: Hey, Uta-san! Mind if I ask you some questions?

records.jp: インタビューを……私に、ですか？
records.en_original: Questions? For me?
records.en: Questions? For me?

records.jp: うん！　この世界に来て<CR>一番、印象に残っていることはなんですか？
records.en_original: Yeah! What do you remember most about your time in this world?
records.en: Yeah! What do you remember most about your time in this world?

records.jp: そうですね……<CR>陽桜莉さんや美弦さんと親しくなれたこと、です
records.en_original: Hmm... Perhaps becoming close friends with Hiori and Mio.
records.en: Hmm... Perhaps becoming close friends with Hiori-san and Mio-san.

records.jp: そっか……<CR>ふたりとは、元の世界でいろいろあったんだっけ
records.en_original: I see... You three had been through a lot before you came to this world, right?
records.en: I see... You three had been through a lot before you came to this world, right?

records.jp: はい。<CR>でも……きっかけを作ってくれたのは……
records.en_original: Yes. But the person that brought us togther...
records.en: Yes. But the person that brought us togther...

records.jp: ……星崎さん。<CR>あなたの手は、いつも暖かいですね
records.en_original: Was you, Ao. Your hands are always so warm.
records.en: Was you, Hoshizaki-san. Your hands are always so warm.

records.jp: ……詩さん？
records.en_original: Uta...?
records.en: Uta-san...?

records.jp: すみません。<CR>星崎さんが、とても心細そうに見えたものですから
records.en_original: I'm sorry. You seemed like you were in need of some comforting.
records.en: I am sorry. You looked so lonely and uneasy, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 私は……元の世界へ戻るのが怖いです。<CR>その資格が私にあるとも思えません……
records.en_original: I...I'm afraid of returning to our world. I don't think I even deserve to.
records.en: I...I'm afraid of returning to our world. I don't think I even deserve to.

records.jp: 私が過去の私に呑まれずにいられたのは、<CR>みなさんが……星崎さんが傍にいてくれたからです
records.en_original: The only reason I was able to resist being taken over by my past self was because everybody stood by me. Especially you, Ao.
records.en: The only reason I was able to resist being taken over by my past self was because everybody stood by me. Especially you, Hoshizaki-san.

records.jp: 元の世界で全てを忘れてしまったら、<CR>私はもしかしたらまた、昔のように――
records.en_original: If I forget everything in returning to our world, I worry that I will end up—
records.en: If I forget everything in returning to our world, I worry that I will end up—

records.jp: ならないよ、詩さん
records.en_original: You won't, Uta.
records.en: You won't, Uta-san.

records.jp: もし全部忘れちゃっても、みんなと離れ離れに<CR>なっても、ここでの詩さんは、詩さんの中にいるよ
records.en_original: Even if you forget everything, even if we are torn far apart, the Uta I know will always be within you.
records.en: Even if you forget everything, even if we are torn far apart, the Uta-san I know will always be within you.

records.jp: 私の中に……？
records.en_original: Within me...?
records.en: Within me...?

records.jp: うん。だから大丈夫。みんなのことだって、<CR>忘れちゃっても、会えばきっと思い出せる
records.en_original: Yeah. So, don't worry. Even if you forget everyone, I'm sure it'll come back to you.
records.en: Yeah. So, don't worry. Even if you forget everyone, I'm sure it'll come back to you.

records.jp: （そっか……私、不安だったんだ。<CR>詩さんの話で、気が付いた。私も同じなんだって）
records.en_original: (I get it now... I've been afraid too. Talking to Uta helped me realize that.)
records.en: (I get it now... I've been afraid too. Talking to Uta-san helped me realize that.)

records.jp: 星崎さんの手……やっぱり暖かいです。<CR>この暖かさも、私の中に必ず残ると思います
records.en_original: Your hands... They're so warm, Ao. I know this warmth will remain with me.
records.en: Your hands... They're so warm, Hoshizaki-san. I know this warmth will remain with me.

records.jp: ですから……<CR>元の世界でも、こうして手を繋いでくれますか？
records.en_original: So, will you hold my hand again in our world too?
records.en: So, will you hold my hand again in our world too?

records.jp: もちろんだよ。<CR>また手を繋いで、一緒にひまわりを見よう
records.en_original: Of course I will. Let's hold hands and go see some sunflowers.
records.en: Of course I will. Let's hold hands and go see some sunflowers.

records.jp: あの、動画……消してしまったんですか？
records.en_original: The video you took... Did you just delete it?
records.en: The video you took... Did you just delete it?

records.jp: うん。だって、こんなの必要ないって<CR>詩さんが気づかせてくれたから
records.en_original: I did. You helped me see that I don't need it, Uta.
records.en: I did. You helped me see that I don't need it, Uta-san.

records.jp: ふふ……いつもの星崎さんの笑顔です
records.en_original: Hehe... There's the smile I know.
records.en: Hehe... That's Hoshizaki-san's usual smile.

records.jp: （……ありがとう、詩さん。詩さんのおかげで<CR>何が一番大切なのか分かったような気がする）
records.en_original: (Thank you, Uta. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)
records.en: (Thank you, Uta-san. Had it not been for you, I wouldn't have realized what was most important.)

records.jp: （みんなとの思い出は、私の心に記録しよう。<CR>絶対に消えないように……刻み込むんだ！）
records.en_original: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
records.en: (I'll keep our memories in my heart forever. I will never forget them!)
